text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock A repeatedly after large gains, so I should avoid trimming a winner automatically just because its gain feels good; use a clear target and reassess its prospects.","I sold Stock B and E at steep losses only after holding on, which suggests I may resist admitting mistakes; set objective risk limits and review losing positions sooner.","My account fell in periods 9 and 10 despite earlier gains and a new Stock C purchase; monitor overall risk and diversification, and avoid trading—or refusing to act—just from short-term emotions."]}
